messages.subject: secr 2.9.0 in Mavericks
parts:
I see that secr 2.9.0 fails checks for r-release-osx-x86_64-mavericks because other packages are not available to run the examples (‘spsurvey’ and ‘rgeos’, but specifically ‘rgdal'). I expect this will mean no binary is provided by CRAN. You have the option of downloading and installing from the source secr_2.9.0.tar.gz. It will be a few weeks before I fix this in secr 2.9.1.
Murray
